title: iOS 27 beta 6 now available as Apple tests major Siri AI upgrade - 9to5Mac
summary: Apple has released the sixth iOS 27 beta for developer testing. iOS 27 beta 6 continues Apple’s summer beta cycle ahead of a public release in September. Today’s developer beta release will likely become iOS 27 public beta 4.
